pages.title: Energetic Module
pages.text: Start an outdoor array with an Energetic Photovoltaic Module.

pages.title: Panel Composite
pages.text: Smelt two composites together for one Photovoltaic Plate. Each batch uses 5,600 FE in the Alloy Smelter.

With clear sky at midday, Energetic, Pulsating and Vibrant modules peak at 4, 16 and 64 FE/t by default. Adjacent modules on the same level share a buffer. Take FE from the side or below and store the daytime surplus in a $(l:enderio:power/banks)bank$(/l).

Liquid Sunshine beside a daytime module gives full output, even under a roof. A Phantom-bound module generates at night. Place Liquid Darkness beside it for full output. Bind the Phantom in a $(l:enderio:souls/binder)Soul Binder$(/l).
